submittedParameters.prompt:
Edit image 1 into the single transparent game animation frame W05. Image 1 is the authoritative exact leg pose to preserve. ONLY redraw upper-body chest/back orientation and arms above the belt; use image 2 as corrected upper-body/camera guide. Keep every leg, knee, ankle, shoe, hem crossing, boot position and sole ground contact from IMAGE 1. Do not use image 2 legs. The RIGHT recovery knee is lifted FORWARD at SCREEN LEFT, its boot floats at about (0.44,0.81), toe points LEFT. The LEFT SUPPORT boot is planted BEHIND at SCREEN RIGHT about (0.62,0.94). The support sole stays horizontal.
Upper body must match image 2: west/left-facing stable left-side/back view, anatomical LEFT arm is NEAR camera and carries the green-gold round shield on SCREEN LEFT/CENTRE; anatomical RIGHT arm is FAR and holds the one staff behind body at SCREEN RIGHT. Show connected shoulder-elbow-wrist, one fist wrapped around shaft, and exactly TWO arms with two hands. Left shield grip is naturally hidden behind shield, no extra hands. No chest-front camera flip. Keep identity, mature polished chibi painting, orange-brown hair, golden armor, white sleeves, green-gold panels, beads. Image 3 is original identity, image 4 same-direction idle, image 5 style. Head shape, whole-body scale and foot horizontal ground line match image 1. Preserve current distinct stride phase; it is NOT the common front-boot planted/back-boot bent pose. Specifically SCREEN LEFT boot is IN AIR and SCREEN RIGHT boot is ON GROUND. Full single character, actual alpha, no text, no scenery, no shadow, no multi-panel. Preserve feet, only correct upper body. Target configured GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst / max; host-managed model/quality unconfirmed.
